/* DROP SCRIPT

DROP SECURITY POLICY [RLS_BNKM].[POL_BNKM]
DROP FUNCTION RLS_BNKM.AccessPredicate
DROP SCHEMA RLS_BNKM

*/


CREATE SCHEMA RLS_BNKM
GO

-- Creation of security function.
-- Function to define what will be use as filter on tables
CREATE FUNCTION RLS_BNKM.AccessPredicate(@BankID varchar(20), @SourceSystemCode varchar(50))
    RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
    RETURN SELECT 1 AS AccessPredicateResult 
FROM DW.RefRowLevelSecurityFilter ref_rls
WHERE ref_rls.UserEmail = USER_NAME() AND
(
@BankID = BankID AND @SourceSystemCode = SourceSystemCode

)


-- Assigning of security filter per table
